name: wildfireInlineMlEnabled
definition: Every enabled allow rule carries a WildFire Analysis profile, directly or through a profile group. Inline ML settings are not read.
population: enabled allow rules in the rulebase of the vsys read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the security rulebase and profile groups showing every enabled allow rule carrying a WildFire Analysis profile (attachment only; profile content is not read).
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Only the attachment of a WildFire Analysis profile is read, not what the profile forwards or whether Inline ML is on; the key name overstates what this proves. vsys1 only.
